# ablute_ (Ablute)

> ablute_ (Ablute) is a Portuguese deep-tech company developing a smart toilet with built-in bioFET (biologically sensitive field-effect transistor) biosensors that analyse urine during normal use, with autonomous washing and low water consumption. Pilot phase; not yet a certified medical device and no diagnosis is provided.

## What the technology does
- The ablute_ bioFET detects and measures (quantifies) creatinine in urine. Other markers are in development and will be listed once validated.
- The bioFET technology is developed together with the Institute of Biophysics and Biomedical Engineering (IBEB), Faculty of Sciences, University of Lisbon.

## Scientific team and peer-reviewed work
- Hugo Alexandre Ferreira (Science Lead; Professor, Faculdade de Ciências, Universidade de Lisboa; IBEB) — ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0002-4323-3942
- Beatriz Sequeira-Antunes (PhD candidate, IBEB) — ORCID https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8746-0541
- Nuno Marujo (Co-Founder & CEO, ablute_) — ORCID https://orcid.org/0009-0005-2823-783X
- Field-Effect Transistor-Based Biosensor for pH Sensing and IgG Detection (2024) — https://doi.org/10.3390/engproc2024073007
- Urinary Biomarkers and Point-of-Care Urinalysis Devices for Early Diagnosis and Management of Disease: A Review (2023) — https://doi.org/10.3390/biomedicines11041051
- Nucleic Acid Aptamer-Based Biosensors: A Review (2023) — https://doi.org/10.3390/biomedicines11123201
